widgets_values: Add one woman reclining across the sculptural chair in a fashion-editorial pose: she lies back along the chair's curve with her torso twisted toward the camera, one arm thrown up above her head, the other hanging loose toward the floor, chin lifted and eyes closed, long hair falling off the seat, one bare foot pointed. She wears a flowing terracotta silk dress whose skirt spills over the chair and pools on the orange floor, the fabric catching the sun with a soft sheen so the body reads as one long diagonal from the raised wrist to the pointed foot. Add nothing else and keep the monstera plant and the side table with the vase exactly where they are. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the orange walls and floor, the arched window with its bright blue daytime sky and white clouds, the orange furry leaf-shaped object hanging from the coiled cord, the pale sculptural chair, the shadows and the same camera angle.
